correctness.rationale: The theorem's central table ('exact maximum of R over all primitive chi, all a, all M, all 1<=N<=q') is numerically false for 4 of 5 moduli. Recomputing max-R directly from the committed envelope CSVs (max_N env[N]/(sqrt(N) q^(3/16) log q)) gives TRUE maxima strictly above the reported values: q=25: true 0.3637001630928107 at N=8 (reported 0.3293580374213483 at N=17, excess +0.03434); q=27: true 0.2928313274018646 at N=8 (reported 0.2760840231329556 at N=9, +0.01675); q=49: true 0.3154039064698714 at N=10 (reported 0.2760189196914482, same N=10 but wrong triple: reported |S|=7.047 vs envelope 8.053, +0.03939); q=121: true 0.2495841606870482 at N=15 (reported 0.2152686026952103 at N=40, +0.03432). Only q=9 (0.4505560523783483 at N=7) is correct. Root cause identified in verify_twist.py envelope_for_q: per (j,a) block it takes argmax of |S| over the (M,N) matrix (i = unravel_index(argmax(Amat))), computes R only at that max-|S| N, then maximizes over blocks. This collapses the N dimension prematurely: the global max-R triple need not maximize |S| within its own (j,a) block (R divides by sqrt(N), so smaller-N triples with slightly smaller |S| win). E.g. q=49 N=10: independent pure-Python brute gives max|S|=8.052516286532 at (j,a,M)=(16,40,3), R=0.31540, which the script never evaluates because for (j,a)=(16,40) its recorded argmax-N is elsewhere. Independent verification performed: (i) full pure-Python/no-numpy brute for q=9 reproduces the envelope for all N and the global max-R to 2e-16; (ii) spot brute at the true-max N for q=25 (N=8: max|S|=6.054892877838, R=0.36370), q=49 (N=10, above), q=27 (N=8: max|S|=5.064177772476, R=0.29283) all match committed envelopes to 1e-12, confirming the envelopes (max|S| per N) are correct and only the max-R reduction is wrong. Secondary correctness overclaim: the table is presented as 'exact maximum ... equals the tabulated value' to 16 digits and 'proved (machine-verified exact enumeration)', but all values come from floating-point complex exponentials (numpy/cmath) with no interval arithmetic; dual-path agreement (<7e-14) bounds the reported |S| digits empirically but no rigorous error bound is proved, so 16-digit 'exactness' is unsubstantiated even after the reduction fix. Positive notes: generator/primitivity/count claims check out ((q,g,phi,nprim) = (9,2,6,4),(25,2,20,16),(27,2,18,12),(49,3,42,36),(121,2,110,100), consistent with phi(q)(1-1/p)); M-coverage via length-2q prefix arrays is complete by q-periodicity; the rounded uniform majorant 0.451 still majorizes the TRUE maxima (global true max 0.45056 at q=9, margin ~4.4e-4), so the corollary bound survives but the theorem's exactness/per-modulus values do not.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison against the four nearest results in the lane brief: (1) Treviño explicit Burgess (pure multiplicative sums mod prime, no additive twist, no prime-power modulus); (2) Jain-Sharma/Khale/Liu composite Burgess (uniform-over-composites pure sums, no twist); (3) Cochrane-Granville mixed sums mod prime powers (complete-period sums only, no short-interval N<<q Burgess shape); (4) Bordignon-Francis PV-constant improvement (orthogonal mechanism). None states, implies, or tabulates short additively-twisted prime-power maxima max_{M,a,chi}|S|/(N^{1/2}q^{3/16}log q) for q in {9,25,27,49,121}, and the lane's internal scan of 20 failed attempts and 20 resultary findings covers disjoint domains/objects. No prior anticipation of these specific numbers was found, and the draft claims no method originality (prefix sums, discrete logs acknowledged standard). Priority is judged on this substantive non-overlap, not on timestamps. The narrowness/arbitrariness of the five-modulus set is a value defect, not an originality defeat: the numbers are new but routine-generated.

value.rationale: Even corrected, the surviving result is a five-modulus floating-point enumeration fragment with no demonstrated downstream use, i.e. an unexplained enumeration / tiny unmotivated gain under audit policy. The lane's motivating target (twist-uniform C2<=2.2 for all q>2e5, exhaustion to Q0=2e5, >=15% improvement over evaluated Trevino/Jain-Sharma constants, N0(q) crossover atlas) is explicitly disclaimed in DRAFT sections 2/4/5; no evaluated-constant comparison, no N0(q) map, and no newly-nontrivial (q,N) wedge are offered. The fallback citable deliverable in topic.json was a complete table for all odd prime powers q<=2e5 (~thousands of moduli) usable for least-nonresidue/L-function N0(q) work; five moduli {9,25,27,49,121} do not cover the documented vacuous wedge and cannot substitute for it. The shape constant 0.451 has no analytic content (small-modulus observation, not a general Burgess constant) and at these moduli the majorant is often vacuous against trivial N (e.g. q=121,N=15: burg 20.6 vs trivial 15; q=25,N=8: burg 7.5 vs trivial 8, marginal; vacuous at all small N), with no comparison showing it beats any published bound anywhere. Method is acknowledged standard. A five-entry max-R table of this kind, standing alone with limitations (i)-(iv), is not independently worth finding/citing later; correcting the four wrong table entries would not change this judgment.

decisive_checks: Independent brute-force confirmation: full q=9 census matches committed envelope all N and max-R to ~2e-16; spot brutes match committed envelope |S| to 1e-12 at true-max N (q=25/N=8: 6.054892877838; q=27/N=8: 5.064177772476; q=49/N=10: 8.052516286532 at (j,a,M)=(16,40,3) vs reported (4,14,30) with |S|=7.047) — proves envelopes right, max-R reduction wrong; defect traced to per-(j,a) argmax(|S|) before R evaluation in verify_twist.py lines 42-46.

Verified surviving majorant: TRUE global max across family is 0.4505560523783483 (q=9), so |S|<=0.451 N^{1/2}q^{3/16}log q holds on the five moduli with margin ~4.4e-4 — corollary survives, exact table does not.

Vacuity/value check: burg-vs-trivial comparison (q=121,N=15: 20.59 vs 15; q=25,N=8: 7.51 vs 8) shows no demonstrated newly-nontrivial wedge; no evaluated Trevino/Jain-Sharma comparison or N0(q) atlas present — value failure independent of the numerical fix.
residual_risks: After any fix, 16-digit 'exact' maxima would still rest on floating-point exponentials without interval-arithmetic certificates; only a rounded majorant with explicit error budget (current dual-path agreement <1e-13 vs 4.4e-4 margin) is defensible without stronger certification.
True-max argmax triples for q=25/27/121 were located in N only ((N=8,8,15)); full corrected (j,a,M,N) triples were not exhaustively re-certified here beyond q=49/N=10 spot (16,40,3).
No conclusion is offered about any q outside {9,25,27,49,121}; general Burgess constant C2, Q0 exhaustion, and crossover claims remain unproved by the authors' own disclaimer.
